n_frames.why: the ticket's own self-check -- 'the vanilla cells must match the #019 headline run, because views and protocols are not in the split digest' -- only works at the frame count the reference used. The published #019 headline is results/fovbench-rectfix-393cab9/partA_6seq: 6 sequences x 50 frames, digest 601fcb22767e. 25 frames reproduces no published digest on this box; the older 25-frame run (fovbench-main-22c108d / 2ab412af0ccc) is a ONE-sequence run from when only 1 of 20 ADT sequences carried all three streams, and there are 6 now.

deviations_from_the_ticket.da3_small_added: costs ~85 s and turns the self-check from three exact-match rows into four. fovbench aligns and scores per model, so adding one cannot perturb the others -- and the self-check below confirms it did not.

workers.why: fovbench deadlocks on this box at dav2_large at any thread count above 1: 498 threads at --workers 8, 754 at --workers 16, every one sleeping in futex_wait, GPU 0%, no frame line ever printed. Not starvation (469 GB RAM free, load 2.3/64 cores) and not the HF Hub (dav2_large alone scores a frame in 6 s, online or HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1). _ordered_map pools rows in split order so serial is bit-identical to threaded, and tests/test_end_to_end.py pins that -- confirmed here by the self-check, which is exact against a reference produced with --workers 16.

self_check.what: views and protocols are not in the split digest, so this run carries the same digest as the #019 headline and its vanilla fisheye/radial cells must match it

expected_to_move.why: the reference predates ticket 021, which opened the bf16 autocast VGGTBackbone is written to expect. Its vggt_1b column is fp32. Well inside #021's measured <=0.51% bound.

headline.read_the_bins_not_the_pool: vggt360 and vggt_1b are level on pooled AbsRel (0.1198 both) and that hides the entire result. By eccentricity, real stream, centre bin -> rim bin: vggt_1b 0.0957 -> 0.1529 (1.60x), vggt_omega 0.0574 -> 0.1160 (2.02x), da3_large 0.0778 -> 0.1515 (1.95x), vggt360 0.1240 -> 0.1295 (1.04x). vggt360 is WORSE at the centre than the VGGT-1B it wraps and BETTER at the rim, crossing over around 40 deg.
headline.caveat: NOT resolution matched, and it favours this row: the nine tangent views are cut from ADT's native 1408 frame (0.62x downsample to 518) while the vanilla models see a 518 resize (from which the same views would be 1.69x up). How much of the rim advantage is the lens treatment rather than the source resolution is exactly what run C measures, and run C is not in this artefact yet.

log_lines_the_tables_cannot_carry.constant_fill: PASS, by silence. fovbench/models.py:_report_holes prints 'N% of the imaged cone had no view covering it and was filled with a constant' only when the worst-seen fraction exceeds 1%. It never printed across all 300 frames, so the ring tiled its cone within 1% throughout — which is what the ticket predicted ('expect well under 1%'). Absence of the line IS the result here; do not read it as the diagnostic not running.
